title: Build the pure Hunt graph validator and evaluator
detail:
Frequency Hunts slice FH-007. A dependency-free module at lib/hunts/graph/ (no DB, no Next, no network). validateGraph(graph) returns actionable blockers (cycles, missing refs, impossible count thresholds, impossible windows, unreachable finish, no free path, 30-mission and 100-edge limits) and never throws. evaluate(graph, credits, now) returns sorted eligible, unlocked and credited mission keys plus whether the finish is reached: ALL, ANY, N-of-M over distinct buckets, [open, close) UTC windows, one credit bucket per mission, keys only (no locked content), same output whatever the input order. Exclusive branches (choice_group, fallback_group) are a documented TODO for FH-042.

Shipped in this PR: lib/hunts/graph/ with 32 vitest cases (Trail, Passport 3-of-5, Rally fixtures, order independence).
